title: DICOM RT DVH Validation: an intermediate data layer for dose-volume parameter extraction
description:
Validation software for the use of DICOM RT DVH files at 1 cGy resolution as an intermediate caching layer between DICOM-RT source data held in a PACS and downstream clinical data repositories.

Contains the DVH computation and caching modules, the dose-volume parameter extraction code, the six-phase experiment runner and the unit test suite used to validate the cache against analytical phantoms, published reference values and treatment planning system data. Tolerance thresholds were pre-specified and locked before any experiment was run, and the complete experiment is deterministic and reproducible from the published scripts.

Clinical DICOM data are not included and cannot be shared due to institutional data governance requirements.
